models.name: discussion_board_categories
models.description: Article categories for organizing economic and political discussion topics. Categories provide the primary taxonomy structure for content organization, enabling users to browse articles by subject area (e.g., Economic Policy, Political Analysis, International Trade). Referenced by discussion_board_article_categories for many-to-many article relationships.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category display name (e.g., Economic Policy, Political Analysis). Human-readable label shown in UI.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the category's purpose and scope. Helps users understand what content belongs in this category.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier derived from name (e.g., economic-policy). Used in routes and permalinks for SEO-friendly URLs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was created. Automatically set on record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last modified. Automatically updated on any change.

models.name: discussion_board_tags
models.description: Flexible topic tags for article labeling and discovery. Tags provide granular, user-generated keywords that complement the formal category structure, enabling detailed content filtering and discovery (e.g., monetary-policy, climate-change, taxation). Tags are normalized to lowercase for consistency. Referenced by discussion_board_article_tags for many-to-many article relationships.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tag name normalized to lowercase (e.g., monetary-policy, healthcare-reform). Ensures consistency and prevents duplicate tags with different capitalization.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier derived from name. Used in routes and tag browsing pages for SEO-friendly URLs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tag was first created. Automatically set when tag is added to system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tag was last modified. Updated when tag is renamed or merged with another tag.

models.name: discussion_board_guests
models.description: Guest users who browse the discussion board without authentication. Guests have read-only access to public content and cannot create articles or post comments. This table tracks guest sessions for analytics and rate limiting purposes.

plainFields.name: session_token
plainFields.description: Unique session identifier for tracking guest activity across requests.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest user for security monitoring and rate limiting.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser user agent string for analytics and compatibility tracking.

plainFields.name: last_activity_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the guest's most recent activity for session management.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

models.name: discussion_board_members
models.description: Registered and authenticated users who can create articles, post comments, and engage in discussions. Members are the core participants of the discussion board with full content creation and interaction privileges. Supports email verification, soft deletion for account recovery, and comprehensive privacy controls.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Unique username for member identification and login. Must be 3-30 characters, alphanumeric with underscores and hyphens only.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for authentication, notifications, and account recovery. Must be unique and verified.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name shown publicly instead of username. 1-50 characters.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Optional member biography or self-description. Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Optional geographic location (free text). Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: website_url
plainFields.description: Optional personal or professional website URL.

plainFields.name: profile_picture_url
plainFields.description: URL of the member's profile picture. Falls back to default avatar if null.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the member's email address has been verified. Must be true to post content.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status: pending_email_verification, active, suspended, or deleted.

plainFields.name: profile_visibility
plainFields.description: Profile visibility setting: public, members_only, or private.

plainFields.name: activity_visibility
plainFields.description: Activity history visibility: public, members_only, or hidden.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the member's most recent successful login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member profile was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft-deleted. Null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description: Active session tracking for authenticated members. Records login sessions for security auditing, concurrent session management, and activity tracking. Follows standardized session table pattern with exact required fields.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the member connected for this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to this session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session end time (nullable).

models.name: discussion_board_moderators
models.description: Trusted users with elevated permissions to manage content, enforce community guidelines, and moderate discussions. Moderators can edit or delete any content and manage user accounts for community health. Supports same authentication and profile features as members plus moderation-specific permissions.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Unique username for moderator identification and login. Must be 3-30 characters, alphanumeric with underscores and hyphens only.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for authentication, notifications, and moderation alerts. Must be unique and verified.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name shown publicly instead of username. 1-50 characters.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Optional moderator biography or self-description. Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Optional geographic location (free text). Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: website_url
plainFields.description: Optional personal or professional website URL.

plainFields.name: profile_picture_url
plainFields.description: URL of the moderator's profile picture. Falls back to default avatar if null.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the moderator's email address has been verified. Must be true for moderation actions.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status: pending_email_verification, active, suspended, or deleted.

plainFields.name: moderation_permissions
plainFields.description: JSON string defining specific moderation permissions and access levels for this moderator.

plainFields.name: profile_visibility
plainFields.description: Profile visibility setting: public, members_only, or private.

plainFields.name: activity_visibility
plainFields.description: Activity history visibility: public, members_only, or hidden.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the moderator's most recent successful login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderator profile was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderator account was soft-deleted. Null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_moderator_sessions
models.description: Active session tracking for authenticated moderators. Records login sessions for security auditing, concurrent session management, and moderation activity tracking. Follows standardized session table pattern with exact required fields.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged moderator's {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the moderator connected for this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to this session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session end time (nullable).

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description: Main article entity for economic and political discussions. Articles are the primary content type created by members and moderators, containing title, body content, and metadata. Articles can have multiple categories and tags through junction tables, and maintain version history through snapshots. Supports soft deletion for content recovery.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Author member who created this article. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: last_modified_by_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator who last modified this article, if applicable. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title, between 5 and 200 characters. Used for display in listings and search results.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main article content, between 20 and 50000 characters. Supports rich text formatting and contains the full article text.

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Optional article excerpt or summary, maximum 500 characters. Used for previews in article listings.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Publication status of the article. Values: published, draft, archived. Controls article visibility and lifecycle.

plainFields.name: view_count
plainFields.description: Number of times this article has been viewed. Incremented on each article page visit.

plainFields.name: comment_count
plainFields.description: Cached count of comments on this article. Updated when comments are added or removed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was originally created. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was last modified. Updated on each edit operation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, article is hidden from public view but retained for recovery and audit purposes.

models.name: discussion_board_article_snapshots
models.description: Historical snapshots of article content for version control and audit trails. Each snapshot captures the complete state of an article at a specific point in time, preserving title, body, and metadata. Snapshots are created on article creation and each subsequent edit, enabling rollback and change tracking.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent article this snapshot belongs to. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: created_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who created this snapshot version, either the original author or an editor. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title at the time of this snapshot. Preserved for historical accuracy.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Article body content at the time of this snapshot. Complete content preserved for version comparison.

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Article summary at the time of this snapshot, if provided.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Article status at the time of this snapshot. Values: published, draft, archived.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Marks the point in time this version was saved.

models.name: discussion_board_article_categories
models.description: Junction table establishing many-to-many relationship between articles and categories. Articles can belong to multiple categories for flexible organization, and categories can contain multiple articles. Used for article organization and category-based browsing.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the article in this relationship. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the category in this relationship. {@link discussion_board_categories.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this article-category association was created.

models.name: discussion_board_article_tags
models.description: Junction table establishing many-to-many relationship between articles and tags. Articles can have multiple tags for detailed topic classification, and tags can be applied to multiple articles. Used for tag-based search and content discovery.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the article in this relationship. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the tag in this relationship. {@link discussion_board_tags.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this article-tag association was created.

models.name: discussion_board_comments
models.description: User comments on articles in the discussion board. Comments enable discussion and engagement on economic and political topics. Supports single-level threading where comments can be top-level (direct responses to articles) or replies to other top-level comments. Comments can be created by both members and moderators, with authorship tracked through author_type discriminator and corresponding foreign keys.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article this comment belongs to. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_parent_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment for single-level reply threading. Null for top-level comments, references another top-level comment for replies. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member author if comment was created by a member. Mutually exclusive with discussion_board_moderator_id. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator author if comment was created by a moderator. Mutually exclusive with discussion_board_member_id. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}

plainFields.name: author_type
plainFields.description: Discriminator indicating author type. Valid values are member or moderator. Determines which author foreign key is populated.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Comment text content. User-submitted comment on the article or reply to another comment. Length between 1 and 5000 characters as per requirements.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was originally created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last modified. Updated on edits.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if comment is active, set to deletion time if comment was deleted. Enables comment recovery and audit trail.

models.name: discussion_board_comment_snapshots
models.description: Historical snapshots of comment edits for audit trail and version control. Each snapshot captures the comment state at a specific point in time, enabling comment edit history tracking and potential rollback. Snapshots are append-only and never modified after creation.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Comment this snapshot belongs to. Multiple snapshots track edit history. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Denormalized snapshot of comment content at the time of this snapshot creation. Preserves historical content even if parent comment is later modified or deleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Represents the point in time this version of the comment existed.

models.name: discussion_board_article_images
models.description: Image attachments for discussion board articles. Stores images in supported formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP) with a maximum size of 5MB per image. Images are displayed inline within articles and can be viewed at full resolution. Each image is associated with a parent article and tracked with uploader information and upload timestamp.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article that this image is attached to. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: uploaded_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who uploaded this image attachment. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: original_name
plainFields.description: Original filename of the uploaded image as provided by the user.

plainFields.name: stored_name
plainFields.description: Unique filename used for storage to prevent conflicts and ensure security.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the image file (e.g., image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp) for validation and proper content delivery.

plainFields.name: size_bytes
plainFields.description: File size in bytes. Maximum allowed is 5MB (5,242,880 bytes) for images.

plainFields.name: width
plainFields.description: Image width in pixels. Used for validation (minimum 50px, maximum 8000px) and display optimization.

plainFields.name: height
plainFields.description: Image height in pixels. Used for validation (minimum 50px, maximum 8000px) and display optimization.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was uploaded to the system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was soft deleted. Null if the image is active. Images are deleted when parent article is deleted or when removed by author/moderator.

models.name: discussion_board_article_documents
models.description: Document attachments for discussion board articles. Stores documents in supported formats (PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT, RTF, ODT) with a maximum size of 10MB per document. Documents are provided as downloadable links with file metadata. Each document is associated with a parent article and tracked with uploader information and upload timestamp.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article that this document is attached to. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: uploaded_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who uploaded this document attachment. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: original_name
plainFields.description: Original filename of the uploaded document as provided by the user.

plainFields.name: stored_name
plainFields.description: Unique filename used for storage to prevent conflicts and ensure security.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the document file (e.g., application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, text/plain) for validation and proper content delivery.

plainFields.name: size_bytes
plainFields.description: File size in bytes. Maximum allowed is 10MB (10,485,760 bytes) for documents.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded to the system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document was soft deleted. Null if the document is active. Documents are deleted when parent article is deleted or when removed by author/moderator.

models.name: discussion_board_reports
models.description: Content reports submitted by members flagging articles or comments that potentially violate community guidelines. Reports are reviewed by moderators who can take appropriate action. Each report targets either an article or a comment (polymorphic relationship) and tracks the reporter, reason, status, and resolution.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reporter who submitted this report. {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: reported_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reported article if the report targets an article. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}. Mutually exclusive with reported_comment_id.

foreignFields.name: reported_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reported comment if the report targets a comment. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}. Mutually exclusive with reported_article_id.

foreignFields.name: reviewing_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator currently reviewing or who resolved this report. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}. Nullable when report is pending.

plainFields.name: report_reason
plainFields.description: Category of the violation being reported (e.g., spam, harassment, misinformation, offensive content).

plainFields.name: report_details
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation provided by the reporter describing why the content violates guidelines.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the report: pending (not yet reviewed), under_review (moderator is reviewing), resolved (action taken), dismissed (no violation found).

plainFields.name: resolution_notes
plainFields.description: Notes from the moderator explaining the decision or action taken on this report.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report was submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report was last updated (status change, moderator assignment, resolution).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail. When set, the report is hidden but preserved for historical records.

models.name: discussion_board_moderation_actions
models.description: Audit log of all moderation actions taken by moderators. Records every moderator intervention including content edits, deletions, user warnings, suspensions, and bans. Provides complete accountability and traceability for all moderation decisions.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator who performed this action. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: related_report_id
foreignFields.description: Report that triggered this moderation action if applicable. {@link discussion_board_reports.id}. Nullable for proactive moderation not triggered by reports.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of moderation action: edit_content, delete_content, restore_content, warn_user, suspend_user, ban_user, lift_suspension, dismiss_report.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Type of entity targeted by this action: article, comment, user, report.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the targeted entity (article ID, comment ID, user ID, or report ID depending on target_type).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason or justification for taking this moderation action.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional details or notes about the action taken, including what was changed or why the decision was made.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderation action was performed.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the action record was last updated.

models.name: discussion_board_user_warnings
models.description: Warnings issued to users for policy violations. Part of progressive discipline system where users receive warnings before suspensions or bans. Tracks warning severity, acknowledgment, and relationship to moderation actions.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: User who received this warning. {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator who issued this warning. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: related_moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Moderation action that resulted in this warning. {@link discussion_board_moderation_actions.id}. Nullable for warnings issued independently.

plainFields.name: warning_reason
plainFields.description: Category or type of violation that triggered this warning (e.g., spam, harassment, off-topic content).

plainFields.name: warning_details
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the violation and what behavior needs to change.

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity level of the warning: minor, moderate, severe. Used for progressive discipline tracking.

plainFields.name: acknowledged_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user acknowledged receipt of this warning. Nullable if not yet acknowledged.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the warning was issued.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the warning record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp if the warning is retracted or removed. Nullable for active warnings.

models.name: discussion_board_user_suspensions
models.description: Account suspensions preventing users from logging in and participating. Tracks suspension duration, reason, and who issued or lifted the suspension. Part of enforcement actions for serious or repeated violations.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: User whose account is suspended. {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: suspending_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator who issued this suspension. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: lifted_by_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator who lifted the suspension early if applicable. {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}. Nullable for suspensions that expired naturally or are still active.

foreignFields.name: related_moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Moderation action that resulted in this suspension. {@link discussion_board_moderation_actions.id}. Nullable for suspensions issued independently.

plainFields.name: suspension_reason
plainFields.description: Category or type of violation that resulted in suspension.

plainFields.name: suspension_details
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of why the suspension was issued and what violations occurred.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the suspension began and the account was locked.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the suspension is scheduled to end. Nullable for permanent bans.

plainFields.name: lifted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the suspension was lifted early by a moderator. Nullable for suspensions that expired naturally or are still active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the suspension record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the suspension record was last updated.
